Kerbside 0.7.24 release trigger.

Purpose: make exact selected-stop/kerb proof part of live retention state. Route continuity and MATCH RETAINED cannot be seeded or reused on an authoritative national stop unless the ordered journey pattern contains that exact stop code. Also fixes the 0.7.23 ordering bug where continuity could be seeded before an opposite-kerb contradiction was checked, carries valid stop proof through safe physical re-keying, and adds behavioural regressions for opposite/right kerb retention.
